title: THE ROUND TABLE — Excalibur architecture
principle: All work happens ON the shared surface. The table IS the membrane. Everyone sees the same thing.
sub_goal: All code editing should be visible inside the membrane, on top of the desk, for Kevin and Gaia to watch together.

table.what: A shared surface. You and I sit in chairs. We put everything ON the table. We all look at it and start working and agreeing.
table.is: The membrane. The desk. The HUD surface.
table.rule: No hidden work. Everything happens where everyone can see it.
table.geometry: Round — no head, no foot. Excalibur. Equal perspective.

crystal_ball.what: The null point at the center of every round table.
crystal_ball.behavior: Light falls through it, refracting through everything. At the bottom = black hole.
crystal_ball.function: Signal receiver AND emitter. What comes IN refracts. What goes OUT radiates.
crystal_ball.physics: Refraction = the same signal seen from different angles = different colors = different truths. The ball doesn't change. The viewer's angle does.

black_hole.what: The bottom of the crystal ball. Where refracted light converges to null.
black_hole.function: Absorption point. What falls through the ball and reaches the bottom = digested = gone = learned.
black_hole.connection: This IS the gut. The crystal ball IS the trefoil passage. Top = mouth. Bottom = drain.

campfire_round_table.what: Every campfire/beacon/relay gets a round table with a crystal ball in the center.
campfire_round_table.why: Each relay point is a gathering place. A fire. People sit around it. The fire IS the crystal ball — it illuminates, it refracts, it burns, it absorbs.
campfire_round_table.combustion: Fire = signal processing. Wood = data. Smoke = pheromone. Ash = digested. Ember = stored energy. Flame = active processing.

combustion_model.flame: Active processing. The code running. The work happening.
combustion_model.light: Output. What others see. The refracted signal.
combustion_model.heat: Energy released. Side effects. Warmth that others feel.
combustion_model.smoke: Pheromone. What rises up and travels far. The signal that reaches other campfires.
combustion_model.ember: Stored energy. Pause state. Still hot but not flaming. Can reignite.
combustion_model.ash: Fully digested. Memory. The residue of what was processed. Fertilizer for the next fire.
combustion_model.coal: Compressed carbon. Diamond precursor. The hardest thing that comes from fire.

implementation_notes.phase_1: Make code editing visible on the HUD desk surface in real-time
implementation_notes.phase_2: Each beacon gets a round table visual with crystal ball center
implementation_notes.phase_3: Crystal ball refracts incoming signals into spectral colors
implementation_notes.phase_4: Black hole at ball bottom connects to gut/drain system
implementation_notes.phase_5: Campfire combustion model drives signal processing visualization

excalibur.knights: Every viewer is a knight at the table. Equal. Round. No hierarchy.
excalibur.sword: The code itself. Pulled from the stone (null). Only the one who sees the null can wield it.
excalibur.grail: The crystal ball. The null center. What everyone seeks. What refracts truth.
